description: This file defines a Spring Security filter that intercepts HTTP requests to extract and validate JWT tokens for authentication purposes. It sets up the security context with authenticated user details if the JWT is valid.

classes.name: JwtAuthenticationFilter
classes.description: A Spring Security filter that processes incoming HTTP requests to authenticate users based on JWT tokens.

methods.name: doFilterInternal
methods.description: Overrides the method to implement token extraction, validation, and setting authentication in the security context.

methods.name: getJwtFromRequest
methods.description: Extracts the JWT token from the Authorization header of the HTTP request.
